headline: TE Connectivity (TEL) Board Member William A. Jeffrey Is Set To Retire
summary: TE Connectivity (NYSE: TEL) announced the planned retirement of Board member William A. Jeffrey from its Board of Directors. Jeffrey’s retirement will change the composition of TE Connectivity’s governing body and its mix of experience on the Board. The Board will move forward with one fewer long serving director once Jeffrey steps down from his role. William A.
